name: web-forager
description: Clean-room, robots-aware web information gathering: multi-engine search, HTML/PDF/Office/feed extraction, Bilibili/Zhihu/Xiaohongshu/WeChat reading, sitemaps and resumable surfing, plus a browser mode with eight read-only playbooks. CLI + two MCP servers.

interface.shortDescription: Polite web fetching, Markdown cleaning and Bilibili browsing.
